invariants: The source allowlist contains only regular non-symlink .py files present in the frozen Git commit.
Tracked Python working-tree bytes must match the frozen source commit before a stage runs.
Frozen source reads create no data-access evidence and cannot satisfy a declared input.
Untracked Python files and tracked non-Python files remain governed data reads.
Git inspection completes before the file-access observer activates.

findings.counterexample: A tracked model.py symlink could redirect the initial implementation to arbitrary workspace bytes.
findings.repair: Reject every symlink in the frozen Python source allowlist.

mechanical_evidence.codeql_selection: 6 selected tests; no deferred tests; no fallback domains; no incomplete declarations

tradeoffs.runtime: Each governed stage runs one Git diff check and one Git tree listing before invocation.
tradeoffs.scope: Only exact tracked .py paths receive source-read treatment; configuration and data files remain declared inputs.

exclusions: Non-Python package resources require explicit data declarations.
The full integration and distribution suites remain session-closure gates.
